what.text: This page follows refugees from New Zealand in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 58 New Zealander refugees, and Australia hosted 43.1% of them.
After Australia, the largest hosts are Germany, Bulgaria and Russia.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for New Zealand, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2005 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
